description_en: Removes one or more virtual server groups
description_zh: 移除一个或者多个虚拟服务器组
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-vserver-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp1fo0dbtsbmqa9h0000 --vserver-group '[{"LoadBalancerId":"lb-bp1p90y3ya9h8s62d0000","VServerGroupAttribute":[{}]}]' --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachVServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides, such as `ap-southeast-1` or `cn-shanghai`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属地域的ID，例如`cn-hangzhou`、`cn-shanghai`。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the instances in the current scaling group from the virtual server groups to be removed. 

true: removes the instances. If you set this parameter to `true`, the system removes the instances that are associated with the scaling group from the backend servers of the load balancing instance when the load balancing instance is removed from the scaling group.

false: does not remove the instances. If you set this parameter to `false`, the system does not remove the instances that are associated with the scaling group from the backend servers of the load balancing instance when the load balancing instance is removed from the scaling group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移除虚拟服务器组中移除当前伸缩组内的实例。 

true：移除。如果该参数取值为`true`，则从伸缩组中移除负载均衡实例时，系统会将负载均衡实例后端服务器上与伸缩组关联的实例移除。

false：不移除。如果该参数取值为`false`，则从伸缩组中移除负载均衡实例时，系统不会从负载均衡实例后端服务器上移除与伸缩组关联的实例。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

fields.help_en:
The ID of the load balancing instance to which the virtual server group belongs.

N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

You can remove up to five load balancing instances from a scaling group at a time
fields.help_zh:
虚拟服务器组所属负载均衡实例的ID。

N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

支持最多一次从伸缩组移除5个负载均衡实例
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en:
The port number used by Auto Scaling to add ECS instances or elastic container instances to the virtual server group. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

The first N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

The second N specifies the virtual server group number under the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到虚拟服务器组时使用的端口号，取值范围：1~65535。其中：

第一个N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

第二个N为负载均衡实例下虚拟服务器组的编号，取值范围：1~5
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the virtual server group.

The first N specifies the load balancing instance number. Valid values: 1 to 5.

The second N specifies the virtual server group number under the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh:
虚拟服务器组ID。其中：

第一个N为负载均衡实例编号，取值范围：1~5。

第二个N为负载均衡实例下虚拟服务器组的编号，取值范围：1~5
